posts.cooked:
On another thread, I mentioned that I’ve been thinking for a little while how cool it would be to have a SotM side-scrolling fighting game, 2D or 3D. I just thought “Hey, that would be pretty cool.” But no, I’m not going to make one myself, because I don’t know how to program flash (or anything). Still, I like the idea of it and just imagining what it would be like. Then, since I play a lot of Mortal Kombat, I got to thinking how amazing it would be to do what DC did and have a crossover between MK and SotM (mainly just because that’s my favorite). So, I came up with this list of hypothetical fights in the hypothetical MK vs. SotM:

Legacy vs. Johnny Cage
Absolute Zero vs. Sub Zero
Bunker vs. Cyrax/Sektor
Ra vs. Scorpion
Haka vs. Nightwolf
Visionary vs. Shang Tsung
Tachyon vs. Kabal
Tempest vs. Raiden
Wraith vs. Noob Saibot
Fanatic vs. Quan Chi

But it doesn’t just have to be MK; I wanna hear what you guys have thought of (if anything). In a Sentinels fighting game, what kind of things would happen (special moves, etc.)? Any other awesome crossover ideas? Again, just be as out there as you wanna be. This is just all for fun of thinking of ideas.

posts.name: evandan457
posts.cooked: Yeah, Smash Bros. is pretty good at having a good cast of unique characters, but I think their best appeal is the whole “pick up and play” part. I really do like that, where you can be good without the hours of practice and memorization. I still have fun with MK, but obviously just about all big-name fighting games take some good practice and reflexes to be good at. And, plus, those big name games have hordes of people who are just a bit too good and take it far too seriously (Street Fighter). But still, I manage to have fun, despite usually getting destroyed when playing online.

posts.name: TheJayMann
posts.cooked:
It was a DOS fighting game engine made some time ago. It allows one to create characters, stages, and even alter the look and feel of the interface to basically create a fighting game. And each of these three are independent of each other, allowing you to create (and download) all you want. There are characters already made for most Capcom and MK games, they have Mario Bros characters, The Simpsons characters ( http://www.youtube.com/watch?v=jP7CfbpMmwk http://www.youtube.com/watch?v=rCVtII0FNGY http://www.youtube.com/watch?v=akG4BMuARxs http://www.youtube.com/watch?v=wFlWW2fWZq8 ), and almost anyone you can imagine. I used to play it quite a bit, but then I got tired of fighting games in general, and haven’t played in some time.

A Windows beta had been released, but afterwards the original company stopped development (I don’t think they even exist anymore). Recently there has been an attempt to create a new engine that works with all existing characters/stages/etc and runs on XNA (Windows, XBox, Windows Phone).
